items.headline: US Voters Cast Ballots in 2026 Midterm Elections to Determine Control of Congress
items.summary: Millions of Americans voted on November 3 in high-stakes midterm elections that will determine control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate. The election outcomes will shape federal legislative priorities and executive oversight for the remaining two years of President Donald Trump's term.

items.headline: NASA's 20-Year-Old Swift Space Telescope Plunges Back to Earth in Uncontrolled Reentry
items.summary: NASA's 3,200-pound Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory, launched in 2004 to study high-energy cosmic explosions, is re-entering Earth's atmosphere on November 4, 2026. Space agencies predict that most of the satellite will safely burn up during reentry, concluding a historic two-decade astrophysics mission.

items.headline: Manchester United Mounts Dramatic Champions League Comeback to Defeat AS Roma 3-2
items.summary: Manchester United staged a dramatic 3-2 comeback victory over AS Roma in the UEFA Champions League at Old Trafford after trailing by two goals early in the match. The victory on Tuesday snapped a nine-game winless streak for the English club and provided crucial relief for manager Michael Carrick.

items.headline: Bethesda Officially Unveils 'The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel' Title
items.summary: Bethesda Game Studios announced 'The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel' as the official name of the long-awaited role-playing game during a video celebrating the developer's 40th anniversary on November 3, 2026. The brief teaser highlighted desert landscapes and lore hints that indicate the game will be set in the region of Hammerfell.
